title: Rav Ada bar Avin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Keritot 21a](https://www.sefaria.org/Keritot.21a.10), while [Yoma 74b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.74b.1) reads Rav Idi bar Avin.[^1]

notes.text: The two passages discuss the koy and name Rav Ada and Rav Idi respectively. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=225&lang=en) also records Idi as an alternative reading in Keritot.
